cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)
project(DommySourceManifestCheck LANGUAGES NONE)

if(NOT DOMMY_REPOSITORY_ROOT)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "DOMMY_REPOSITORY_ROOT is required")
endif()
include("${DOMMY_REPOSITORY_ROOT}/cmake/DommyActiveSources.cmake")
set(_relative_sources)
foreach(_source IN LISTS DOMMY_ACTIVE_CPP_SOURCES)
    file(RELATIVE_PATH _relative "${DOMMY_REPOSITORY_ROOT}" "${_source}")
    list(APPEND _relative_sources "${_relative}")
endforeach()
string(REPLACE ";" "\n" _source_lines "${_relative_sources}")
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/active_sources.txt" "${_source_lines}\n")
